body:
Real research: Twilio Elastic SIP Trunking requirements (SIP methods, transports, IP ACL vs Credential List auth, real IP/port ranges), grounded via web search. Maps onto sip/message.prn+net/udp.prn. Key finding: pure RTP relay needs zero codec work. Named gaps: SDP, SIP proxy header-rewriting, multi-fd poll concurrency, digest auth. 5-phase plan. Commit 738f7c5. Planning only.

⚓ ☃
title: SIP-Twilio gateway research + plan (kanban SIP-001)
